arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4827] URGENT — why am I being logged out every time I switch machines??
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for reaching out, and I'm very sorry you're suddenly experiencing this disruption after a year of stable use. I understand how important uninterrupted access is for your workflow.

Based on your description—getting logged out of Cursor on one device each time you sign in on another—this is not an intended policy change or normal behavior. Cursor does not intentionally limit how many devices you can be signed into at once, especially for Pro accounts. You should be able to remain signed in on all your machines.

New device-related payment verification ("device binding") only applies to billing actions like changing plans or adding seats—not to ongoing sign-in sessions. The sign-in sessions should be independent per device.

Since this is a new, urgent issue impacting your work, I've flagged your case internally for investigation. If you have time, could you let us know:
- When exactly you first noticed this behavior
- Whether you received any errors/pop-ups when re-signing in
- If you use any browser extensions or settings that clear cookies/session data

Meanwhile, you should not need to reverify payment or change your login method, and you should be able to stay logged in everywhere as before. If you are comfortable sharing, any extra details about device OS/version or browser used could help us resolve this even faster.

We'll update you as soon as we know more. If you're still seeing this after today or if you lose work again, please let us know right away. Thank you for your patience.

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Support

arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4815] Invoice PDF won't download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for letting us know you're unable to download your March invoice as a PDF in Cursor. If the download button spins indefinitely, the most likely cause is either a caching issue or an active popup/cookie/content blocker in the browser.

Here are a few steps to try:
1. Clear your browser cache and try the download again.
2. Try opening the download page in a private/incognito window.
3. Temporarily disable any browser extensions that might block downloads or interfere with file saving, then retry.
4. If you're using a company VPN or firewall, try disabling it briefly or using a personal network to see if the issue persists.

If none of these work, please reply with any error message (if shown) and let me know which browser versions you tried. I'm happy to retrieve the invoice manually if needed—just say the word.

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Support

arguments.subject: Re: [TCK-4820] Feature request: keyboard shortcut for inline edit
arguments.body:
Hi Riya,

Thank you so much for your suggestion! Currently, triggering inline edit in Cursor requires either the mouse or using cmd-K to search, as you've described—the app does not yet support a built-in keyboard shortcut dedicated solely to opening inline edit. You're not missing anything; there isn't a direct shortcut for this function yet.

I've recorded your request for our product team. We appreciate clear, specific feedback like this because it helps us prioritize our roadmap based on real user workflows. While I can't promise an immediate ETA, your vote for a keyboard-only inline edit trigger has been counted and the team will review it for a future release.

If you have any other workflow suggestions or accessibility needs, please let us know.

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
Cursor Support
